items.title: Chimacum Creek
items.description: Chimacum Creek is a stream in Jefferson County, Washington, United States. Located on the base of the Quimper Peninsula in the northeast of the larger Olympic Peninsula, the main stem originates from a series of springs and ponds in the forested hills south of Discovery Bay. items.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
items.description: Legislative elections were held in Israel on 27 October 2026 to elect the 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: Susan Saint James
items.description: Susan Saint James was an American actress. In 1968, she landed a role as Peggy Maxwell on the TV series The Name of the Game. Saint James received three Emmy Award nominations for the series, winning once in 1969. items.title: Gadi Eisenkot
items.description: Gadi Eisenkot, also spelled Eizenkot, is an Israeli general, politician, and leader of the Yashar party. He served from 2015 to 2019 as the 21st chief of staff of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) and from 2023 to 2024 as a minister without portfolio in Israel's unity government. items.description: Elizabeth Anne Holmes is an American businesswoman convicted of fraud in connection with her health technology company Theranos.
